paper.title: LIMO: Less is More for Reasoning

result.summary: 本文挑战了「大模型复杂推理需要海量训练数据」这一假设，提出 LIMO 假设：在预训练已充分编码领域知识的基础模型上，少量但精心设计的认知过程示范即可激发复杂推理 [S3.p1]。作者通过多层筛选从数千万数学题中构建了仅 800 条样本的 LIMO 数据集，并对 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 做简单 SFT [S1.p4]。结果显示 LIMO 在 AIME24 上达到 63.3%、MATH500 上达到 95.6%，仅用先前方法 1% 的训练数据 [abstract]，并在分布外任务上持续优于用 100 倍数据训练的模型 [S1.p4]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：大模型的复杂推理是否真的需要海量训练数据，还是可以通过极少量高质量样本激发出来 [abstract]。作者指出，此前关于数据效率的研究（如 LIMA）虽强调质量优于数量，但能否推广到推理任务仍不确定，因为推理任务可能具有很高的计算复杂度 [S2.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: We challenge the prevailing assumption that complex reasoning in large language models (LLMs) necessitates massive training data.
However, whether this lesson can be applied to reasoning tasks remains uncertain, given the potential high computational complexity of such tasks.

method.text: 作者提出 LIMO 假设：在预训练已充分编码领域知识的基础模型中，复杂推理能力可通过少量但精确编排的认知过程示范而涌现，该假设依赖两个前提——模型参数空间中潜在存在先备知识，以及能将复杂问题分解为详细逻辑步骤的高质量推理链 [S3.p1]。据此，作者构建了一套多层数据筛选流程：先用 Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct 做粗难度过滤，再用 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 对每题采样 32 次、保留仅解出 1–3 次的难题，得到 2,125 题的 LIMO-Pool [S3.SS1.SSS1.p3]；随后按质量评分排序取前 800 条构成 LIMO 数据集 [S3.SS1.SSS2.p7]。训练上对 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 做全参数 SFT，学习率 5.0e-6、余弦衰减、无 warmup、15 个 epoch、batch size 64 [S4.p2]。

evidence.quote: In foundation models where domain knowledge has been comprehensively encoded during pre-training, sophisticated reasoning capabilities can emerge through minimal but precisely orchestrated demonstrations of cognitive processes.
The latent presence of prerequisite knowledge within the model’s parameter space
we first applied a baseline difficulty filter using a short-CoT mathematical model, Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct.
Problems that were successfully solved in only 1–3 out of 32 attempts were retained, yielding a refined dataset of 2,125 problems
we selected the highest-scoring solution for each problem, ranked these pairs by quality score, and extracted the top 800 to form the LIMO Dataset.
We fine-tune Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct using supervised fine-tuning on our LIMO dataset.
we utilize a learning rate of 5.0e-6 with a cosine decay schedule.
The model is trained for 15 epochs with a batch size of 64 examples

experiments.text: 评估覆盖域内与分布外两类基准：域内包括 AIME24、MATH500、AMC23 等数学推理基准 [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]；分布外包括 OlympiadBench、新构建的中文多语言基准（CHMath、Gaokao、Kaoyan、GradeSchool）以及 Minerva、GPQA 等多学科基准 [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。所有基准采用零样本思维链下的 pass@1 指标，大基准用贪心解码单样本，小于 50 题的小基准（AIME24、AMC23、CHMath）生成 4 个样本（temperature=0.6）并计算无偏 pass@1 [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1]。此外还做了消融研究，比较不同推理链质量、题目难度（Simple-500/Complex-500/Advanced-500）、基础模型（Qwen1.5-32B-Chat 与 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct）、模型规模（3B 到 72B）以及数据量（400 到 2k）的影响 [S6.SS3.SSS2.p1][S6.SS3.SSS3.p1][S6.SS3.SSS4.p1][S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

evidence.quote: we select benchmarks differing from our training data across three categories.

we construct novel multilingual benchmarks using recent examination problems: CHMath (2024 Chinese High School Mathematics League), Gaokao (China’s 2024 College Entrance Exam), Kaoyan (Chinese Graduate School Entrance Exams), and GradeSchool
We evaluate performance using the pass@1 metric in a zero-shot chain-of-thought setting across all benchmarks.
For smaller benchmarks (less than 50 problems: AIME24, AMC23, and CHMath), we generate 4 samples (temperature=0.6) and calculate the unbiased pass@1 metric.
We select three sets of 500 problems with increasing difficulty: Simple-500 (MATH levels 1-2), Complex-500 (MATH levels 3-5), and Advanced-500 (AIME problems).
we compare two 32B-parameter models: Qwen1.5-32B-Chat and Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct (LIMO’s base model).
The performance on AIME24 shows a marked increase with model size, rising from 2.5 for the 3B model to 68.3 for the 72B model.
Figure 7 and Figure 8 present the performance of models fine-tuned on different dataset sizes.

findings.text: 域内任务上 LIMO 在所有基准取得最佳结果：AIME24 达 63.3%，超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 50.0% 和 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 44.6%；MATH500 达 95.6%，超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 89.8% 和 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 85.5%；AMC23 达 96.3%，高于 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 83.6% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。与更大数据集相比，NuminaMath-100k 出现明显退化（32.3% vs 基座模型的 49.9%），OpenThoughts-114k 为 58.3%，而 LIMO 的 800 题达到 78.1% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1]。消融显示：仅改变题目难度即可在 AIME2024 上带来 16% 提升至 51.5%，且仅在 Advanced-500 上微调的模型在 MATH500 上达 91.2% [S6.SS3.SSS2.p1]；基础模型选择影响巨大，LIMO（基于 Qwen2.5）在 AIME2024 上比 Qwen1.5 的 9.2% 高出 54.1 个百分点，在 MATH500 上高出 30.4 个百分点 [S6.SS3.SSS3.p2]；模型规模上 AIME24 从 3B 的 2.5 升至 72B 的 68.3，但 32B 与 72B 在 MATH500 上差距很小（95.6% vs 94.8%）[S6.SS3.SSS4.p1]；数据量上仅 400 样本即将 AIME24 从 16.5 提升到 57.5、MATH500 从 79.4 提升到 94.8，超过 800 样本后收益递减 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

evidence.quote: For AIME24, LIMO achieves 63.3% accuracy, outperforming QwQ-32B-Preview (50.0%) and OpenAI-o1-preview (44.6%) by significant margins.
On MATH500, LIMO achieves a notable 95.6% accuracy, surpassing QwQ-32B-Preview (89.8%) and OpenAI-o1-preview (85.5%).
The performance gap is even more pronounced on AMC23, where LIMO reaches 96.3% accuracy compared to QwQ-32B-Preview’s 83.6%.
NuminaMath-100k shows significant degradation (32.3% vs. base model’s 49.9%) due to uncurated reasoning chains, while OpenThoughts-114k achieves suboptimal results (58.3%)
LIMO’s carefully curated 800 problems yield superior performance (78.1%)
modifying problem selection alone leads to 16% accuracy improvement on AIME2024, reaching 51.5%.
the model fine-tuned on Advanced-500 achieves 91.2% on MATH500 despite no in-domain training data
LIMO (built on Qwen2.5) achieves 63.3% accuracy on AIME2024, a 54.1 percentage point improvement over Qwen1.5’s 9.2%.
On MATH500, LIMO reaches 95.6% accuracy, surpassing Qwen1.5 by 30.4 percentage points.
The performance on AIME24 shows a marked increase with model size, rising from 2.5 for the 3B model to 68.3 for the 72B model.
The difference in performance between the 32B and 72B models is marginal on MATH500 (95.6% vs. 94.8%)
Fine-tuning with just 400 samples yields dramatic improvement over the base model, increasing AIME24 accuracy from 16.5 to 57.5 and MATH500 accuracy from 79.4 to 94.8.
we observe diminishing returns beyond 800 samples

limitations.text: 作者在样本效率分析中指出，超过 800 样本后出现收益递减，2k 数据集虽整体最佳但相对 1.6k 提升极小，说明超过某一阈值后额外数据对微调增益贡献较小 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。作者提出未来工作可探索主动学习策略以进一步优化样本效率 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

evidence.quote: we observe diminishing returns beyond 800 samples, with only marginal increases between LIMO-800 and LIMO-1k2 (+0.9 on AIME24, -0.2 on MATH500), suggesting an early plateau effect.
The highest dataset size (2k) provides the best overall performance (69.6 on AIME24, 95.8 on MATH500), but with minimal improvement over 1.6k
Future work could explore active learning strategies to further optimize sample efficiency.
